genesis.approval_requirement: Any later on-chain application, address, predeploy, namespace, or change to frozen manifest requires separate canonical Genesis and governance approval; this step provides none.

discovery.pattern: approved static environment-configured service endpoints plus versioned service registry metadata; no user-supplied upstream URLs
discovery.trust: TLS with verified service identity and independently approved audience/issuer pins, service account binding and environment isolation
consumers: 420Travel public redacted guidance via its scoped adapter
discovery.availability: failure to resolve, mismatch, expired registration or unavailable service => UNKNOWN and block regulated transaction
discovery.migration: versioned contracts with dual-read only after compatibility review and separately approved migration; no unsecured fallback

publication.strategy: independent qualified reviewer approves immutable source-linked digest; distinct publisher schedules signed manifest
publication.signature: asymmetric Ed25519 selected as off-chain design; canonical serialized bytes, approved key registry and independent signing authority; production keys not provisioned
publication.key_management: environment-scoped managed key/HSM, no private keys in repository, dedicated signer principal, dual control, auditable rotation, key compromise halt
publication.validation: signature/issuer/key status, reviewed exact digest, jurisdiction/domain/audience, environment, effective interval, review freshness, monotonic sequence and revocation epoch; block on mismatch
publication.rollback: only a currently valid independently approved policy; cannot resurrect revoked manifests or compromised keys
publication.emergency: authorized operator may halt region/domain; cannot mint ALLOW or approve a policy

chain_commitment.reason: No demonstrated chain trust requirement that cannot be met by versioned signed off-chain proofs and canonical existing apps.
chain_commitment.allowed_future_content: only minimal nonpersonal digest and version reference after separate review
chain_commitment.requires: canonical change control, privacy threat review, ABI/address authority, testnet and independent release acceptance
